itinerary.title: Welcome to Cairo
itinerary.source: As soon as you touch down, our warm and friendly team will be there to greet you and escort you to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Discover Cairo’s Historic Gems
itinerary.source: Savor an authentic Oriental lunch to fuel your explorations, and later, unwind with a delicious dinner at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Alexandria’s Coastal Charms
itinerary.source: Don’t miss Pompey’s Pillar before enjoying a sumptuous dinner and overnight stay in Alexandria.

itinerary.title: Giza’s Timeless Wonders
itinerary.source: Journey back to Cairo for a day at the iconic Great Pyramids of Giza.

itinerary.title: Abu Simbel’s Magnificence
itinerary.source: Fly to Abu Simbel and tour the awe-inspiring temples carved into rock.

itinerary.title: Luxor’s Ancient Splendor
itinerary.source: After checking into your hotel, experience the Luxor Temple illuminated by night and explore the treasures of the Luxor Museum.

itinerary.title: West Bank Discoveries in Luxor
itinerary.source: Visit Madinat Habu and the majestic Karnak Temple, with an overnight stay in Luxor.

itinerary.title: Cairo’s Spiritual Legacy
itinerary.source: Return to Cairo to delve into its rich religious heritage at the Ben Ezra Synagogue, the Hanging Church, and Abo Serga Church.

itinerary.title: Farewell Cairo
itinerary.source: Enjoy one last breakfast at your hotel.
